title: Kissinger among the first CIC officers in Oberammergau

tellings.quote: Henry Kissinger was one of the first officers to occupy the barracks there in 1945.

plain: In 1945 Henry Kissinger, who later became a top US diplomat, was one of the first officers to move into the barracks at Oberammergau, a town in Bavaria in southern Germany. He was there with the Counter Intelligence Corps, the US Army's spy-catching branch. Michels tells this himself in an episode that asks whether Kissinger oversaw a program to recover crashed UFOs. He brings it up to place Kissinger in intelligence work early in his career.
